lines.text: Forty blue tiles on the edge. Eighty white tiles inside.
lines.caption: Forty blue tiles on the edge. Eighty white tiles inside.

lines.text: Square one foot tiles: forty blue on the edge, eighty white inside.
lines.caption: Square one foot tiles: forty blue on the edge, eighty white inside.

lines.text: How many feet longer than wide?
lines.caption: How many feet longer than wide?

lines.text: The edge is two lengths, plus two widths, minus four corners counted twice.
lines.caption: The edge is two lengths, plus two widths, minus four corners counted twice.

lines.text: So two lengths plus two widths is forty-four. Length plus width: twenty-two!
lines.caption: So two lengths plus two widths is forty-four. Length plus width: twenty-two!

lines.text: All one hundred twenty tiles make length times width.
lines.caption: All one hundred twenty tiles make length times width.

lines.text: Two numbers add to twenty-two, and multiply to one hundred twenty? Twelve and ten! Two feet longer!
lines.caption: Two numbers add to twenty-two, and multiply to one hundred twenty? Twelve and ten! Two feet longer!

lines.text: Why twelve and ten? The full lesson shows a list, a faster way, and every trap.
